title: AI News Daily — August 20, 2026
summary: Anthropic's Q2 revenue topped OpenAI's for the first time, $11.6 billion to $6.7 billion, as OpenAI's operating losses widened to $12.3 billion. OpenAI countered by previewing Private Safety Processing, which it says lets it flag misuse without the 30-day data retention Anthropic now requires. And Unitree's Shanghai IPO surged as much as 630%, valuing the DeepSeek-backed humanoid robot maker near $50 billion.
